# Stat Grid

`stats/stat-grid` &middot; section-level &middot; category: stats

## Purpose

Two to four statistics side by side (1 to 4 columns), with an optional heading.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `stats` | stats |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `heading` | text |  |
| `intro` | text |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Three stats across.
- **two-stat**: Two stats across. Sets `columns: 2`.
- **four-stat**: Four stats across, compact values. Sets `columns: 4`, `statVariant: compact`.
- **tinted**: Three stats on the page background color. Sets `background: @colors.background`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mobileColumns` | one of `2`, `1` | `2` |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `columns` | one of `3`, `1`, `2`, `4` | `3` |
| `statVariant` | one of `default`, `plain`, `compact`, `left` | `"default"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `paddingY` | length | `"@theme.section.paddingY"` |
| `paddingX` | length | `"@theme.section.paddingX"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `mobileColumns`: `2`, `1`. How many columns per row on phones.
- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Each row is a table with exact widths. mobileColumns is ignored. | Two per row on phones uses a media query. Non-Google Gmail accounts show the desktop layout. | Swaps via dm-* classes when on the brand surface or background color. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('stats/stat-grid', {
  "heading": "Trusted by thousands",
  "stats": [
    {
      "value": "98%",
      "label": "Customer satisfaction"
    },
    {
      "value": "50K+",
      "label": "Customers"
    },
    {
      "value": "4.9",
      "label": "Average rating"
    }
  ]
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "stats/stat-grid",
  "data": {
    "heading": "Trusted by thousands",
    "stats": [
      {
        "value": "98%",
        "label": "Customer satisfaction"
      },
      {
        "value": "50K+",
        "label": "Customers"
      },
      {
        "value": "4.9",
        "label": "Average rating"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```
